memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, a research-round report that cites records/milestones.md open decisions by NUMBER goes stale silently whenever the records are rewritten, because the open-decisions list is renumbered without any cross-reference check. Concretely: a report written before commit b63de1dd9 cites 'Open decision 4' for the evaluator-beside-the-lemmas question, which that rewrite moved to decision 2 while giving 4 to the signature-layer timing question. When planning or implementing any round that follows a records commit, sweep the prior round's artifacts with grep -nE 'records/[a-z-]+\.md|\b[A-F][0-9]+\b|[Oo]pen decisions? [0-9]' and re-resolve each hit. Milestone IDs (C3, D4, B4) are stable across rewrites; open-decision ordinals are not, so prefer citing a decision by its question text, not its number.
